arcCreate.title: Create a new story arc
arcCreate.namePlaceholder: e.g. The Shadow of the North
arcCreate.linearDesc: Chapters played in order — classic sequential storytelling.
arcCreate.hubDesc: Parallel quests unlocked by conditions — sandbox style (e.g. Phandalin / Icespire Peak).

arcEdit.subtitle: Story arc
arcEdit.aiAssistantTitle: Open the AI Assistant to discuss this arc
arcEdit.illustrationsHint: Moods, portraits, evocative visuals for the arc. JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF, 10 MB max.
arcEdit.mapsHint: Regional maps and plans to help players locate the action.
arcEdit.namePlaceholder: e.g. The Shadow of the North
arcEdit.synopsisPlaceholder: Describe the main story of this arc...
arcEdit.linearDesc: Chapters played in order — sequential storytelling.
arcEdit.themesPlaceholder: What themes does this arc explore? (betrayal, redemption...)
arcEdit.stakesPlaceholder: What are the major stakes of this arc for the characters?
arcEdit.gmNotesPlaceholder: Your notes on the arc's direction, planned twists, key reveals...
arcEdit.gmNotesHint: These notes are private and will not be exported to FoundryVTT.
arcEdit.rewardsPlaceholder: What rewards will the players gain? Items, levels, knowledge, contacts...
arcEdit.resolutionPlaceholder: How should this arc end? What are the possible outcomes?
arcEdit.relatedPagesHint: Link this arc to NPCs, places or Lore elements. Click a chip to open the linked page.
arcEdit.noLoreHint: 💡 This campaign is not linked to any universe. Link it to a Lore in the campaign screen to be able to link this arc to Lore pages (NPCs, places, etc.).
arcEdit.chatWelcome: I can see this arc. Ask me to enrich its themes, stakes or resolution.
arcEdit.chatSuggestion1: Suggest 3 major themes for this arc
arcEdit.chatSuggestion2: Imagine stakes that put pressure on the players

arcView.deleteTitle: Delete the arc and all its content
arcView.hubQuestsEmpty: No quests for this hub. Create one to get started.
